components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative action beside a primary, or a reversible choice.

components.name: Mobile Place Navigation
components.description: Four fixed places at the bottom on phones; the header keeps Help and Quick exit above it.
components.html: HomeTalkMy notesSupport
components.css: .ds-places { position:fixed; inset:auto 0 0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); background:var(--c-surface); border-top:1px solid var(--c-border-subtle); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom); } .ds-places a { min-height:3.75rem; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--c-muted); text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; } .ds-places a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--c-accent); background:var(--c-accent-soft); } .ds-places a:hover { background:var(--c-surface-quiet); } .ds-places a:focus-visible { outline:var(--focus-width) solid var(--c-focus); outline-offset:var(--focus-offset); } @media(max-width:24em) { .ds-places { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); } }

components.name: Quiet Button

narrative.overview:
Sela is a working room, not a brochure about feeling better. White surfaces and a cool blue-grey ground keep the interface quiet; a cobalt open S and a sculptural paper-fold illustration carry the identity. The folds do not resolve into a tidy shape, which is the point: there is room for a story that is not finished.

The system is compact and legible. It uses one humanist sans, a small radius scale, hairline divisions and only two elevation levels. Coral, lilac and sage appear in the illustration, not as UI status colours. Nothing assesses the person: no scores, progress rings, streaks or before-and-after language.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white reading surfaces on a cool `#EDF0F8` ground.
Cobalt is the single action and identity colour.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px rules; shadows only for sheets and dialogs.
Four-place navigation on mobile; a fixed workspace rail on desktop.
Real states, honest blocked states, and the Help / Quick exit pair always present.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only action and identity accent. The accepted dashboard invitation may carry the accent as a surface; surrounding reading and feature areas stay quiet.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: A heading carries its own weight. Do not place an eyebrow, date, section number or category label above it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface is not floating above the page, it gets a rule or a tint, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep the page ground cool and the welcome surface white.
Do use cobalt for exactly one primary action per view.
Do self-host Manrope and keep text resize, dark mode and high contrast working.
Do state unavailable features and provider limits plainly.
Do keep Help and Quick exit in the same header position on every screen.
donts: Don't reintroduce a serif, paper texture or warm editorial costume.
Don't put a kicker, date or all-caps eyebrow above a heading.
Don't add streaks, points, scores, badges, rating stars or healing promises.
Don't use coral, lilac or sage for UI status; they belong to the illustration.
Don't nest cards, add gradient text/glass, or mix a border with a wide shadow.
Don't present AI as a clinician or imply automatic memory, recipient sharing, appointments or provider readiness that the build does not support.
